return None

try: lang = env.user.lang or '' except Exception: lang = ''
if lang.startswith('ar'): translated = _pattern_translate(text, UI_TEXT_AR) if translated: return translated return text
translated = _pattern_translate(text, AR_TEXT_EN) if translated: return translated
